tagline: YouTube audio to trimmed MP3s, on your desktop
brief: A free, local desktop app for parents: paste YouTube links, trim the start and end of each track, save MP3s onto a child's SD card. It must feel simple and trustworthy, crafted and precise, and work as a Windows/macOS app icon at 16–32 px.
criteria: Success: avoids the play-button and music-note clichés, reads at 16 px, works in one colour, and connects to the app's trim gesture.

concepts.name: Capsule
concepts.idea: The kept sound, punched out of a rounded capsule, with the trimmed-off ends right beside it.
rationale: Tells the product story: keep the middle, cut the ends
A solid, rounded silhouette that holds up as an app icon
A dedicated small-size version keeps it clean at 16–32 px

recommendation: Capsule in pine #1C7B5A (5.2:1 on white), with the lighter pine #5FC199 on dark backgrounds.
next_steps: Replace the Tauri app icons with the new mark
Use the horizontal lockup in the app header and README
Run a trademark search before public release
